newsitem.title: USA: Allegheny Teledyne sells some product lines.
newsitem.headline: Allegheny Teledyne sells some product lines.

text.p: Allegheny Teledyne Inc said Monday that it sold certain product lines of its Teledyne Landis Machine operation, based in Waynesboro, Pa., to Barth Industries of Cleveland, Ohio. Terms of the transaction were not disclosed, but Allegheny said the sale will not have a significant effect on its financial results.
In a statement, Allegheny, a tool and metal manufacturing company, said the operations included thread cutting, thread rolling and gear rolling machines and replacement parts.
Barth Industries Co. is a unit of Cleveland-based Nesco, Inc, a privately held international manufacturing company.
